examples.japanese: お{客|きゃく}{様|さま}がいらっしゃいました。
{田中|たなか}{様|さま}、お{電話|でんわ}です。
examples.english: Mr./Ms. Tanaka, you have a phone call.

examples.japanese: {神様|かみさま}にお{祈|いの}りする。

notes:
〜{様|さま} is a highly respectful honorific.

USAGE:
- Very formal/polite situations
- Customer service
- Business correspondence
- Religious contexts

COMMON USES:
- お{客様|きゃくさま}: customer (honorific)
- {神様|かみさま}: God
- {王様|おうさま}: king
- お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}: thank you for your hard work

NOTE: More formal than 〜さん
